lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 13 distinct vertical white lines. Spacing is relatively uniform across the central torso, with increased density and tighter spacing observed at the posterior and anterior boundaries of the pattern.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line 1 (posterior) is a significantly shortened segment. Lines 12 and 13 (anterior) are truncated and do not reach the ventral torso margin. Various central lines exhibit tapering or minor segment breakage.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A grouping of approximately 9 distinct white spots is localized on the lower posterior haunch and upper hind limb area.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots are aligned horizontally across the lateral aspect of the haunch, positioned inferiorly to the fourth vertical line.

other_distinctive_markers: Single white spot on the lower cheek region and a high-contrast white patch on the ventral neck/throat area.
